type.name: Declared
type.description: A declared identity relation over a carrier R, supplied as an input to the audit. rel r s means the declaration treats r and s as the same. equivalence is the proof that rel is an equivalence relation. How the declaration is derived is justified elsewhere: Declared.ofGenerators, Declared.ofLicence, and Declared.ofClassification build it with Persistence.

type.name: Surface
type.description: An implementation surface over records R with outcomes O. Value is the type of mechanism values. mechanism gives each record its value. uses is the list of identity-relevant uses identified for the mechanism. controlled is surface control: each use depends on a record only through its mechanism value. Whether uses lists every identity-relevant use is a disclosure claim that Lean does not discharge.

type.name: Verdict
type.description: The three audit outcomes. pass: the audit's assumptions are established and faithfulness holds. fail: they are established and a divergence witness exists. indeterminate: they are not established, so no conclusion is justified. Indeterminate is never a pass.
